svg.text: The Big Picture — databases: the record room · the room is in the repo
📇 PART 1 — THE RECORD ROOM (lessons 1–6)
🗄️ why a record room
durable (survives the crash) · shared
(many clerks, one truth) · answerable
(ask in SQL) — sticky notes do none
📇 registers, line numbers, keys
classes → students → grades · primary key =
the line nobody reuses · foreign key = 'see
register X, line 3' — and it cannot point nowhere
🔍✏️ asking and writing — SQL
SELECT · WHERE · ORDER BY · LIMIT · JOIN ·
GROUP BY — you say what, the archivist how ·
BEGIN … COMMIT, or ROLLBACK: the eraser (ACID)
🧩🗂️ one fact one place · the catalogue
normalise: the teacher's phone lives in ONE row ·
CHECK, UNIQUE, FK refuse nonsense · an index turns
SCAN into SEARCH — EXPLAIN shows the route
🔬 db/demo.py + db/migrate.py — Python's built-in SQLite, zero dependencies
schema.sql · seed.sql · reads · join · a rollback · an index race on 200,000 rows · a lock · a restore · N+1
the same ideas in Postgres and MySQL — the lessons say where they differ
⚠️ the two mistakes every first schema makes
one big register with everything copied into it — and no constraints, so bad rows are merely unlikely
one fact, one place; let the schema refuse nonsense; index what you filter and join on
python3 db/demo.py — every lesson's queries, live, in 60 seconds
🏃 PART 2 — RUNNING THE RECORD ROOM (lessons 7–12)
🔒🏗️ two clerks · renovations (7–8)
isolation hides pencil marks · locks make
the second writer wait · deadlock = the
handshake, one victim · short transactions
migrations in git, applied once, logged ·
expand → migrate → contract, school stays open
🧯📈 the fireproof copy · more clerks (9–10)
RPO (how much may we lose) · RTO (how long
may we be shut) · a backup nobody restored is
a rumour · the scaling ladder: queries + indexes
→ pool → cache → bigger box → read replicas
(lag!) → partitions → shard, last
🏘️ other rooms (11)
document · key-value · columnar ·
graph · vector (the VectorDB school) ·
relational is the default room —
pick another only for a question
it answers badly; measure first
🩺 on call (12)
N+1 → one JOIN · the slow-query log,
read weekly · connections, lag, disk,
lock waits, slowest 10, last restore
drill · dashboards: QPS, p95, errors,
cache hit rate
🧭 read one record room, read them all: registers + keys · ask in SQL · write in pencil, commit in ink · one fact one place · a catalogue for hot questions
clerks wait for locks · renovate while open · rehearse the restore · scale in order · other rooms for other questions · watch the slow-query log
siblings: the API school puts the counter in front of this room · the VectorDB school is the meaning hall next door · AWS L17 rents the room (RDS)
